subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers that reject prompt messages in `input`, should OpenClaw support an explicit strict-relay compatibility mode, repair only the reported reasoning-role propagation, or decline this relay class in core?
rationale: The failure is credible, but the permanent fix affects provider compatibility policy and may add a public config contract across incompatible OpenAI-compatible backends.

options.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
options.body: Keep current defaults and accept an opt-in prompt-placement or equivalent compatibility switch with docs, tests, and upgrade-safe validation.

options.title: Repair only reasoning role propagation
options.body: Treat this as a narrow bug if maintainers want `reasoning: true` custom Responses models to send `developer` without adding a new placement mode.

options.title: Decline core support for strict relays
options.body: Keep current behavior and direct affected operators to `openai-completions` or provider-specific workarounds until a broader provider policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and accept an opt-in prompt-placement or equivalent compatibility switch with docs, tests, and upgrade-safe validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current affected provider code was moved into the reusable AI runtime by recent work from this owner, and the decision is provider/API surface policy rather than only a line-level bug.
